name: Defense
setup: Designate one Primary Position. One side is the Attacker; the other is the Defender. The Defender begins in control of the Primary Position.

captureRules.recordingRule: Beginning with Round 2, record control of the Primary Position during each Scoring Phase.
captureRules.captureCondition: The Attacker captures the position by controlling it at the end of two consecutive Scoring Phases.
captureRules.interruption: The sequence is interrupted if the position becomes Contested or Defender-controlled.

victory.attackerWins: The Attacker wins by capturing the position. The Attacker also wins if it controls the position at the end of Round 6.
victory.defenderWins: The Defender wins if neither condition is achieved.

campaignNotes: Defense can represent holding a settlement, assaulting a fortress, securing a strategic route, or protecting a political institution. The actual strategic consequences depend on the established Stake.
